key_fiscal_facts.value_text: Cost recovery per PSC or association contract. Sonatrach minimum 51% equity. Association contracts: cost deduction per Sonatrach-approved limits. PSC: ~60% cost recovery cap standard.

26% Corporate Income Tax (Impot sur les Benefices des Societes — IBS) per Algeria Hydrocarbons Law No 19-13 (2019). Previously 30% pre-2019. Additional 14% withholding on dividend distributions to foreign shareholders. Combined effective burden on distributed profits: ~36%.
Sliding scale: 5.5% for production <20,000 bpd; up to 23% for >100,000 bpd; reduced rates for offshore and tight gas
Sonatrach mandatory minimum 51% equity in all upstream partnerships (Law 19-13 Art.12). Reduced from 70% mandatory in 2005 law — 2019 reform to 51% to attract IOCs. IOC maximum WI: 49%.
